notes: The only San Francisco location on the seed is LOC_003 ('Acme Corp HQ', ORG_002), so it is read as the request's San Francisco data center; its two CIs are CI_003 and CI_004. The request does not ask for the San Francisco location to be deactivated, no original check tests it, and no tool updates a location (add_location and find_locations only), so no requirement tests LOC_003. The policy's CI owner rule (5.1) is met by owner_id; the table has no support_group column.
